Udacity data-science project and web-application prototype.

Classifying disaster-response messages

An NLP pipeline and application for assigning multiple response categories to short messages.

Python · NLTK · scikit-learn · SQLite · Flask · Plotly

The question

Unstructured messages can contain several needs that must be recognized together.

The work

  • Clean and combine message and category data in an ETL pipeline.
  • Store processed data in SQLite and tokenize text for model training.
  • Train and evaluate a multi-output text classifier.
  • Expose message classification and dataset summaries through a Flask application.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Includes the ETL, training and web-app components and an original per-category evaluation report.

What I learned

  • Per-category precision and recall reveal uneven performance that a single headline metric can hide.

Project context

  • Educational prototype, not an operational emergency-response system.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
